Well Dweller - Release Date Reveal Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020145/

From the creator of Islets & Crypt Custodian comes a new fairytale. At the bottom of a well, lives the only creature brave enough to challenge the queen - a tiny bird. Well Dweller is a dark fairytale adventure launching September 22nd, for PS5! Full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom, play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.
